description: Single source of truth for performance-gate thresholds and baseline compatibility. Local recipes and CI read this file; neither carries its own copy.

allocation_gate.threshold_note: 3.000 is the measured value on this tree (see docs/release-checklist.md, Invariant proofs). The gate is 'no regression', so the threshold IS the baseline; raising it is a decision to accept a regression and must be made in this file, in review.
